notes: Module IDs and DIDs from PLAN.md §1.2/§1.3/§6.4. 'verified' is true once a value is confirmed on the car (against the dash, or by the check in 'evidence'). Multi-byte values are big-endian; 'offset' counts from the first data byte after the DID echo; value = raw * scale + add.

signals.name: Odometer
signals.evidence: Matches the dash; tracks GPS distance within 3 % (2026-09-28/29).

signals.name: HV state of charge
signals.evidence: Matched the dash on 2026-09-28 (64 %); read 75.1 % against a dash 74 % on 2026-09-29. See soc_2047..2049.

signals.name: 12 V battery
signals.evidence: ≈14 V with the car on, as expected with the DC-DC running.

signals.name: Vehicle speed
signals.evidence: r = 0.999 against GPS speed over a 32 min drive; reads ≈3 % below GPS, like the odometer (2026-09-29). Same value on every module.

signals.name: HV pack current
signals.evidence: Positive while discharging. Integrated over a drive: 5.65 kWh vs 5.54 kWh from the SOC drop at 113 kWh; r = 0.89 against a tractive-power estimate (2026-09-29).

signals.name: HV pack voltage
signals.evidence: 391–413 V, sags under load; ≈102 × cell voltage (BMS 2136–2138). 2109 and 2117 read the same within 1 V.

signals.name: Battery temperature
signals.evidence: 22.1–22.3 over a drive; 2089–2094 agree within 0.2. Scale is a guess.

signals.name: SOC candidate (2048)
signals.evidence: Lowest of 2047–2049; possibly minimum cell SOC.

signals.name: SOC candidate (2049)
signals.evidence: Between 2047 and 2048; possibly average cell SOC.

signals.name: Tyre pressure 1
signals.evidence: Zero until the TPMS sensors wake (≈20 min of driving); then 0xC1–0xC3. Scale (0.2 psi) and wheel order are guesses: compare with the dash.
